scenarios.name: Import settings while another command is staged on the same target

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
ribbon customization shows 2D Sketches applied to the Part Tools target
a settings file contains 2D Sketches on Part Tools with Large and Text unchecked
3D Annotations is staged after 2D Sketches on Part Tools but has not been applied
the user imports the settings file
the Part Tools target shows only 2D Sketches with Large and Text unchecked
3D Annotations is available in the source list
the Part Tools target shows a pending-change marker
the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog
